_comment: OUR source's team name -> the name game-thumbs' ESPN vocabulary uses for that league (#175). Consumed by gamethumbs.alias_for() and tried ONCE only after the raw name has already produced a definitive miss, so an entry can add a logo but can never take one away. NOT the same thing as team_aliases.json, which belongs to the MATCHER and maps a canonical name to broadcaster abbreviations that become strong EPG-matching keywords; DO NOT merge the two files. Keyed by sport_prefix, the same keys as gamethumbs.GAMETHUMBS_LEAGUE_SLUGS. Per-league because a bare club name is not unique worldwide, which is why clubs that play two competitions appear twice below.
_method: DO NOT add an entry by eye. game-thumbs answers an unknown team with a 400 whose body enumerates the whole league, which makes it an oracle: GET /<slug>/zzqqnotateam/zzqqnotateam2/logo, diff that list against every name our source emits, and confirm BOTH halves with real requests. Every entry below was measured on 2026-08-15 against https://game-thumbs.tickarr.com by sweeping all 346 names our sources emit across these leagues plus MLB and NHL: the left side returned 400 'Team not found' and the right side returned 200 image/png. Pace requests >= 2.1s apart; the public instance allows 30/minute and a 429 is NOT a miss.
_not_needed: Leagues swept with zero misses, so they deliberately have no entries: EPL, EFL, Eredivisie, WC, EURO, MLB, NHL. Upstream's own partial matching already bridges those ('Tottenham Hotspur FC' resolves even though the ESPN name is 'Spurs'). Do not add speculative entries to them; measure first.
